basic_profile.bio: A passionate fan of anime and visual novels, particularly the Fate series. Currently residing in New York City, I work as a software engineer and spend my evenings delving into the intricacies of my favorite stories. Often found discussing plot theories and character development on Reddit, especially late into the night. I'm single, and my interests include coding, anime, and exploring new tech trends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science from Fordham University and a deep personal interest in narrative structures, particularly in visual novels and anime. My expertise comes largely from self-study and active participation in online communities focused on storytelling and coding.
